stages.name: Idea
stages.when: No docs/brief.md, or the product changes

stages.name: Design
stages.when: A brief with UI, no DESIGN.md

items.name: idea
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: An idea, or a repo with no docs/brief.md
items.why: Grill it into docs/brief.md: problem, people, core flows, key screens, surface, v1, out of scope.

items.name: design
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A brief with UI, no DESIGN.md, or what next on the look
items.why: Reads the project and suggests the next design skill. The way in.

items.name: design-brief
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: Before any other design skill
items.why: The designer's questions: feel, never, apart from, fixed. Writes docs/design/design-brief.md.

items.name: design-moodboard
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A design brief and no references, or a gap
items.why: Read their board or search; they mark likes. Writes docs/design/design-moodboard.md.

items.name: design-families
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A board over about 60 references
items.why: Optional. Sort it into looks; they take one or two. Writes docs/design/design-families.md.

items.name: design-identity
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A design brief, no identity
items.why: Type pairing and colours picked on rendered options; the identity board. Writes docs/design/design-identity.md.

items.name: design-direction
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: An identity and a moodboard, no direction
items.why: First screens dealt from the references in the identity; they pick; a hierarchy pass. Writes docs/design/design-direction.md.

items.name: design-prototype
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A direction, no DESIGN.md, or a feature with screens
items.why: The key screens and states, approved, then DESIGN.md.

items.name: design-figma
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: DESIGN.md, no Ready frames
items.why: Tokens, the identity board, components and Ready frames in Figma.

items.name: design-content
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: Copy or pictures to plan, or no pictures yet
items.why: Optional. What each screen says and shows, stand-in pictures. Writes docs/design/design-content.md.

items.name: design-wordmark
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: An identity, and a mark wanted
items.why: Optional. A mark from the identity's type.

items.name: design-check
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A Figma screen, or a built UI spec, to check
items.why: Against the design rules and the Ready frame. Hard rules block; soft ones are reported.

items.name: figma-use
items.author: Figma
items.when: Before any use_figma call

items.name: figma-generate-library
items.author: Figma
items.when: Figma tokens, styles, or components

items.name: figma-generate-design
items.author: Figma
items.when: A screen in Figma
items.why: From the file's components and tokens.

items.name: figma-design-to-code
items.author: Figma
items.when: A Figma link to build

items.name: animate
items.author: emilkowalski
items.when: They asked to animate a control or a transition
items.why: Read DESIGN.md's decisions first. Decide this one move, then build it.

items.name: jury
items.author: juliobsz
items.when: They asked to jury, score, judge, or roast the design (or a live URL / local build)
items.why: Blind evidence scorecard. Do not redesign. Fixes go to DESIGN.md or Figma. Only when asked.

items.name: web-design-guidelines
items.author: Vercel
items.when: A UI review you asked for

items.name: modern-web-guidance
items.author: Google Chrome
items.when: Writing HTML, CSS, or client-side JS
items.why: Current browser APIs; DESIGN.md decides the look.
items.hint: current browser APIs, needs the network

items.name: security-audit
items.author: Cloudflare
items.when: A security review you asked for
items.why: Look for a broken trust boundary. The full audit runs only when you ask for an audit or a pen-test.

items.name: image-to-code
items.author: Leonxlnx
items.when: A picture you already have
items.why: Build the page from that picture.
